original: The WPRPLACE is a protected national park in the far-west region of New South Wales, in eastern Australia. The 30,866-hectare national park is located approximately 80 kilometres southwest of Bourke, at the junction of the Darling and Warrego rivers. The national park is located adjacent to both the Darling River and the Gundabooka National Park, located to the south-east of the park, and the Toorale State Conservation Area, located to the north-west of the park. The park is jointly managed by the NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service and the local indigenous Kurnu-Baakandji people.
translated: Der WPRPLACE ist ein geschützter Nationalpark im äußersten Westen von New South Wales im Osten Australiens. Der 30.866 Hektar große Nationalpark liegt etwa 80 Kilometer südwestlich von Bourke, an der Kreuzung der Flüsse Darling und Warrego. Der Nationalpark liegt neben dem Darling River und dem Gundabooka National Park, südöstlich des Parks, und dem Toorale State Conservation Area, nordwestlich des Parks. Der Park wird gemeinsam vom NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service und den einheimischen Kurnu-Baakandji verwaltet.
